name: Biological Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Fall 2027 admissions confirmed. One Biological Sciences application requires choosing one of two distinct program areas. Regular MCDB uses rotations; E&E normally applies through a mentor; advanced entry directly joins a lab.

applicationFee.note: Same fee domestic/international. Dietrich hardship and qualifying affiliations considered case by case; international outside-fellowship route explicitly mentioned. Confirm eligibility. Survey before payment; allow up to 7 business days per Biology page, no refunds, one code per application.

english.note: IELTS each section 6.5. These are Dietrich/Biology published thresholds; exemptions not established on opened pages. Upload DET reportPDF per FAQ.

documents: Ranked list of four tenured/tenure-stream Biological Sciences faculty
requirements.note: Typical preparation biology or related science/engineering degree, research aptitude and academic proficiency; GPA reviewed in context, not a rigid 3.5 cutoff. Personal statement covers motivation, scientific experience, research goals and community contribution. No additional writing sample required. Advanced entry for master-equivalent applicants requires prior supporting mentor agreement and accepts year-round applications.

funding.note: Every admitted student supported throughout graduate career regardless of citizenship: stipend, full tuition/no fees and health benefits. Normal Fall 2026 rate$35,196/year, not a Fall 2027 promise; first two semesters department fellowship, thereafter normally advisor/TA support.
